nodes.speaker: clerk_moth
nodes.text: Badge visible. Coat ticket. No loitering. Violations are… discouraged with paperwork.

faculty_interjections.text: Do not joke about badges. He will escalate.

choices.text: Present badge. Smile with eyes only.
Ask about study annex access — politely, like a form.
Joke that the badge is shy.

nodes.speaker: clerk_moth
nodes.text: Acceptable. Do not touch coats that are not yours. That is theft and aesthetics.

nodes.speaker: clerk_moth
nodes.text: Study annex is for authorised quiet people. You may be quiet. Authorisation is a different religion. Bring a host signature or leave the furniture alone.

nodes.speaker: clerk_moth
nodes.text: Humour is not a credential. Heat noted. Metaphorically. Also on the incident log.
